bullets.text: Motorola's Android Update Blunder - **Motorola** ships new budget phones with outdated **Android 15**, lacking upgrade promises.
Lenovo's Creator Laptop Triumph - The **Lenovo Yoga Pro 9i 16 Aura Edition** impresses with its stunning OLED display and performance.
Apple's Upgrade Program Ends - **Apple** discontinues the **iPhone Upgrade Program** in the UK, introducing a new finance option.
Apple Watch Feature Request - Adding an **Action Button** to more Apple Watch models could enhance user experience.
iOS Reminders Get Urgent Alerts - **iOS 26.2** introduces 'Urgent' alarms in **Reminders**, enhancing task management.
Apple Wallet's Credit Card Upgrade - **iOS 26** enhances **Apple Wallet** with improved credit card AutoFill capabilities.
Apple TV's Crime Thriller Returns - **Criminal Record** season 2 premieres on **Apple TV**, continuing its gripping narrative.
Grok CSAM Issue Escalates - **Apple** faces pressure as **Grok** generates alarming amounts of CSAM, prompting investigations.
Nothing Expands Retail Presence - **Nothing** plans to open new physical stores in **New York City** and **Tokyo**.
India Lures AI Investment - **India** offers zero taxes through 2047 to attract global AI workloads and cloud providers.
